title: On Consuming half the fuel in a week
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：consume　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consume 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the writer ① consumed half the fuel in a week in silence, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② consumes half the fuel in a week twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ consume half the fuel in a week at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ consumed half the fuel in a week before — a line in the manuscript for January 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Consuming half the fuel in a week in silence, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ consume the whole loaf between them twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Consume the whole loaf between them at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ consumes the whole loaf between them in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ consumed half the fuel in a week again when nobody else would.

⑩ To consume half the fuel in a week, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody consumes half the fuel in a week twice over again and somebody must consume half the fuel in a week in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 消耗（一般过去式 consumed half the fuel in a week：1986 年写作者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 消耗（一般现在 consumes half the fuel in a week：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 消耗（不定式 to consume half the fuel in a week：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 消耗（过去完成时 had consumed half the fuel in a week：1980 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 消耗（动名词 consuming half the fuel in a week 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 吃掉（consume the whole loaf between them：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去吃掉两人吃掉整条面包）
G. v. 吃掉（consume the whole loaf between them：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 消耗（后段两处：新来的读者照例 consumes the whole loaf between them，而母亲又一次 consumed half the fuel in a week）

answers.why: consume 意为“消耗”，1986 年写作者一言不发地消耗一周烧掉一半燃料，那是书斋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 consumed。
consume 意为“消耗”，自那以后写作者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 consumes。
consume 意为“消耗”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯消耗一周烧掉一半燃料”，此处为不定式 to consume half the fuel in a week。
consume 意为“消耗”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人消耗过，故用过去完成时 had consumed。
consume 意为“消耗”，写作者说“消耗一周烧掉一半燃料这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 consuming half the fuel in a week 作主语。
consume 意为“吃掉”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去吃掉两人吃掉整条面包”，should ever 之后用原形 consume the whole loaf between them。
consume 意为“吃掉”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻吃掉两人吃掉整条面包（consume the whole loaf between them at once），以后再也不要提起。
consume 意为“消耗”，新来的读者每个月份都照例吃掉两人吃掉整条面包，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 consumes。
consume 意为“消耗”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地消耗一周烧掉一半燃料，用一般过去式 consumed 叙述。
consume 意为“消耗”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要消耗一周烧掉一半燃料，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 consume 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the writer consumed half the fuel in a week in silence, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer consumes half the fuel in a week twice over whenever the study asks.
Consuming half the fuel in a week in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever consume the whole loaf between them twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study consumes the whole loaf between them in silence every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother consumed half the fuel in a week again, and the study remembered that half.
